notes.title: Corona Simulator Halloween Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
Sorry that I didn't update earlier, but I was very busy with my other project Raidborn, I am working on for nearly two years now. But back to the topic. The Halloween Update brings the requested save feature into the game, so whenever you leave the game now, it will automatically save your progress and you can continue at any time, which is especially helpful at harder difficulties as one round can take up to an hour. Additionally, I also did some heavy rebalancing, with the goal to make each resource equally useful. I think the update will make the game a much better experience. For the future I also plan to make a larger update, bringing more content and completely new features, together with a relaunch of the game, so stay excited.

Update in a nutshell:

 New save feature
 Events rebalanced
 Measures rebalanced
 Bugfixes


P.S.: You would do me a great favor, if you could write a review for the game. Thank you!

Stay cool
Markus (Phodex Games)
